title: Come in, Amy. / What must I do?
subtitle: 进来，艾米。/ 我该做什么？

lead.question: 妈妈让艾米进房间收拾，从「关门、开窗、铺床」到「别把花瓶放那儿」，这一连串家务指令英语怎么说？
lead.warmup: 第 29 课是一段「收拾房间」的指令流：Come in. Shut the door. Open the window and air the room. Make the bed. Dust the table. Sweep the floor. 全是祈使句。然后两次出现新句型 What must I do? —— must 表示「必须」。最后琼斯先生喊 Don't put it there! 又回到否定祈使。先看图，试着用英语给自己列一条「收拾清单」。
goals: 能用祈使句发出家务指令（Come in. / Shut the door. / Make the bed.）
能用 What must I do? 询问「我该做什么」，并用 You must … 回答
能区分肯定祈使（Put …）与否定祈使（Don't put …）
认识家务动词：air, dust, sweep, empty, sharpen, put on
lead.summary: 第 29 课琼斯太太指挥艾米收拾卧室：开关门窗、把衣服放进衣柜、铺床、掸梳妆台、扫地；艾米问 What must I do?，琼斯太太用 You must … 回应。琼斯先生最后喊 Don't put it there! 把花瓶放窗边。第 30 课把 __ must __ 铺开十组（I must empty the bottle / You must open the window…），巩固 must 表义务。
lead.tips: ① 祈使句动词原形开头，加 please 更礼貌；② must 是情态动词，后接动词原形，表「必须」，无第三人称 -s：He must wait.；③ What must I do? 答 You must + 原形；④ 否定祈使 Don't + 原形（Don't put it there!）；⑤ air the room 使房间通风，make the bed 铺床，sweep the floor 扫地，都是固定搭配。

questions.q: What does Mrs. Jones say about the flowers and the vase?
questions.zh: 琼斯太太对花和花瓶说了什么？
questions.a: Those flowers are lovely, but they are not in that vase; put them in this vase, then on the table.
questions.aZh: 那些花很漂亮，但没在那只花瓶里；把它们放进这只花瓶，再放到桌上。
questions.hint: 听 Look at that vase! Those flowers are lovely. But they're not in that vase. Put them in this vase.

questions.q: What does Mrs. Jones tell Amy to do first?
questions.zh: 琼斯太太先让艾米做什么？
questions.a: Come in, shut the door, open the window and air the room.
questions.aZh: 进来，关门，开窗给房间通通风。

questions.q: What must Amy do after airing the room?
questions.zh: 艾米通风之后必须做什么？
questions.a: Put the clothes in the wardrobe, make the bed, dust the dressing table, sweep the floor.
questions.aZh: 把衣服放进衣柜、铺床、掸梳妆台、扫地。
questions.hint: Then put these clothes… / Then make the bed… / Dust… / Then sweep the floor.

questions.q: Where does Mr. Jones finally tell Amy to put the vase?
questions.zh: 琼斯先生最后让艾米把花瓶放哪儿？
questions.hint: Put it here, on the window.

questions.q: Why is 'must' used for chores instead of 'can' or 'want'?
questions.zh: 为什么家务指令用 must 而不是 can 或 want？
questions.a: must expresses obligation/duty (what one has to do), which fits instructions like 'make the bed'. can shows ability, want shows desire — neither conveys the needed 'you have to'.
questions.aZh: must 表义务/必须，契合「铺床」这类指令；can 表能力，want 表意愿，都不表达「你必须」。
questions.hint: 指令是「非做不可」，所以用 must。

questions.q: ___ must ___. (I must empty the bottle. / You must open the window and air the room.)
questions.zh: 第 30 课操练：___ 必须 ___。（把下面 10 组主语与动作挨个说一遍）
questions.a: I must wash the dishes and dry the dishes.
questions.aZh: 我必须洗盘子并把它们擦干。
questions.hint: must + 动词原形，无第三人称 -s。

examples.en: Open the window and air the room.
examples.zh: 打开窗子，让房间通通风。

examples.en: Then put these clothes in the wardrobe.
Put these clothes in the wardrobe.
You must put on your shoes.
Open the window and air the room.

grammar.title: 祈使句（复习与否定）
grammar.structure: 原形动词 (+ 宾语/状语) / Don't + 原形
grammar.definition: 祈使句动词原形开头，表命令/请求；否定式 Don't + 原形。加 please 更客气。

grammar.title: must 的基本用法
grammar.structure: 主语 + must + 动词原形
grammar.definition: must 是情态动词，表「必须、应当」，后接动词原形，无第三人称单数变化。否定 must not / mustn't，疑问 Must + 主语 + 原形?

grammar.title: 家务短语动词（固定搭配）
grammar.structure: 动词 + 名词/副词（整体表一个动作）
grammar.definition: air the room（通风）、make the bed（铺床）、dust the table（掸灰）、sweep the floor（扫地）、empty the bottle（倒空）等，名词/副词不可随意替换。

examples.en: Open the window and air the room.

exercises.a: Come in and shut the door.
exercises.note: 两个祈使句并列用 and 连接。

exercises.q: 把「我必须削铅笔」译成英文。
改写：Put it there.（否定祈使）
exercises.note: 否定祈使 Don't + 原形。

exercises.q: 完成：What ___ I do, Mrs. Jones?（填情态动词）
exercises.note: What must I do? 我该做什么？

exercises.q: 汉译英：把衣服放进衣柜，然后铺床。
exercises.a: Put these clothes in the wardrobe, then make the bed.
exercises.note: put … in 把……放进；make the bed 铺床。

exercises.q: 汉译英：打开窗子，让房间通通风。
exercises.a: Open the window and air the room.
exercises.note: air 此处作动词「使通风」。

drill.zh: ___ 必须 ___。（把下面 10 组主语与动作挨个说一遍，must 后接动词原形）

slots.zh: 你 — 开窗 / 并 — 通风

slots.en: I — dust the dressing table / and — sweep the floor
slots.zh: 我 — 掸梳妆台 / 并 — 扫地

slots.en: you — shut the door / and — clean the blackboard

answers: You must open the window and air the room.

quiz.note: 动词原形开头表请求/命令，是祈使句。
情态动词 must 后接动词原形，无第三人称 -s。

quiz.q: "What must I do?" 的答语应是：
options: You must to open the window.
quiz.note: must + 原形，主语 you 配原形，无 -s。
make the bed 固定搭配，铺床。

quiz.q: He must ___ the floor. 应填：
quiz.note: must 无人称变化，后接原形 sweep。
